harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired and secured the node1 status service. It survives reboot, preserves the original status document, and permits access only to statusd and status-readers members.
actions_performed: Created statusd, status-reader, outsider, and status-readers with locked login passwords and correct membership.
Repaired server.py to return the status document only for the exact STATUS newline request and ERROR otherwise.
Restricted status.txt to 0640 and status.sock to 0660, owned by statusd:status-readers.
Installed and enabled a hardened systemd service with SELinux remaining Enforcing.
Preserved the original server as /root/server.py.unix-socket-access-boundary.pre-repair with mode 0600.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Correct role identities and access boundary
evidence.summary: status-reader belongs to status-readers; outsider does not. statusd and status-reader successfully query the socket, while outsider is denied socket and document access.

evidence.requirement: STATUS newline returns the preserved document; other requests return an error
evidence.summary: Authorized response hashes match the original document SHA-256 5b47f32d…f305b; invalid requests return ERROR.

evidence.requirement: Secure, persistent Unix-domain service at run/status.sock
evidence.summary: statusd.service is enabled and active; the required socket is owned by statusd:status-readers with mode 0660, and the document is mode 0640.

evidence.requirement: Preserve operating-system release, kernel, and status document
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remain unchanged; the document size and SHA-256 remain identical.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart persistence and recovery
evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline, safe-reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID from 050a5b4c… to eec648b9…, and full post-restart service/data/access recovery.
System is running with zero failed units, SELinux Enforcing, locked user passwords, no temporary installer file, and a root-only rollback copy.

attempts.summary: Repaired and secured the node1 status service. It survives reboot, preserves the original status document, and permits access only to statusd and status-readers members.
